req.title: Return all players sorted by id
req.statement: The system shall list players in insertion (id) order on GET /players/.
triggers: return all players sorted by id

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-031 requires GET /players/ to return all players sorted by insertion (id) order. Tests must verify: (1) HTTP 200 status code exactly, (2) all 26 pre-loaded players are returned, (3) the order matches insertion/id order as seeded, (4) response body is a JSON array, (5) each element contains the expected fields. Mutation-resilient assertions check exact count, exact status code, exact first/last player squad numbers, and exact id ordering. Negative path covers invalid HTTP methods. Boundary cases check the first and last elements of the ordered list.

tests.name: test_get_all_players_returns_200_and_all_26_players
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with exactly 26 players
actions: Send GET /players/ with no query parameters
expected: Response body is a JSON array of exactly 26 players
trace: R-PLAYER-031: system shall list players on GET /players/
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_all_players_returns_200_and_all_26_players():
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, list)
    assert len(body) == 26
    for player in body:
        assert 'id' in player
        assert 'squadNumber' in player
        assert 'firstName' in player
        assert 'lastName' in player
        assert 'position' in player

tests.name: test_post_then_get_new_player_appears_last
actions: POST a new player with squadNumber=99
GET /players/ and inspect the last element
expected: Last player in list has squadNumber == 99 (insertion order)
trace: R-PLAYER-031: newly inserted player appears at end of insertion-ordered list
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_then_get_new_player_appears_last():
    payload = {
        'firstName': 'Test', 'lastName': 'Player',
        'squadNumber': 99, 'position': 'Goalkeeper'
    }
    post_r = client.post('/players/', json=payload)
    assert post_r.status_code == 201
    get_r = client.get('/players/')
    assert get_r.status_code == 200
    body = get_r.json()
    assert len(body) == 27
    last = body[-1]
    assert last['squadNumber'] == 99
    assert last['firstName'] == 'Test'
    assert last['lastName'] == 'Player'

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_all_players_count_is_exactly_26_not_25_or_27():

    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    count = len(body)
    assert count != 25, f'Expected 26 players, got {count}'
    assert count != 27, f'Expected 26 players, got {count}'

tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_all_players_squad10_data_correct():
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    squad10 = next((p for p in body if p['squadNumber'] == 10), None)
    assert squad10 is not None
    assert squad10['id'] == 'e51a3744-b879-41cb-a100-533f9d5a0bc6'
    assert squad10['firstName'] == 'Kabir'
    assert squad10['middleName'] == 'Mary'
    assert squad10['lastName'] == 'Reddy'
    assert squad10['position'] == 'Right Winger'
    assert squad10['league'] == 'Ligue 1'
    assert squad10['starting11'] == False
